findings.description: When the last attempt fails, the loop breaks and the method falls off the end, so it returns None. It does not re-raise the GatewayError. settle_invoice then takes the success path: it sets the status to PAID and reads `charge.id`, which raises AttributeError on None. This happens on any persistent gateway failure, so the invoice is not marked PAYMENT_FAILED. The AttributeError escapes settle_invoice and aborts the whole settle_open_invoices batch. The invoice is left in an inconsistent state: status already set to PAID, but charge_id never assigned.
findings.suggestion: Re-raise the last GatewayError after the final attempt. Replace the `break` with `raise`, or save the exception and raise it after the loop.
findings.title: charge() returns None after exhausting retries instead of raising
